menus.name: Ryota Premium Tasting menu
menus.note: Dinner only, Monday to Saturday; a fixed seasonal menu chosen by the chef, HK$1,580 to HK$1,780 depending on the season's produce. Sake and wine pairing offered, price not published

menus.name: Ryota Kappou Lunch
menus.note: Lunch only, Monday to Saturday; a choice of four dishes, from HK$680

menus.name: Miyazaki Wagyu Sukiyaki lunch
menus.note: Lunch only, from HK$880; sukiyaki with seasonal maki, rice or udon and dessert

bookingOpens: By request through the online form on Bistrochat, by WhatsApp (+852 6768 1128), phone or email (info@ryota.hk). Mention any allergies or dislikes when booking, as the menu is fixed by the chef.
cancellation: Cancelling two days before costs 40% of the menu price for each guest booked, the day before 60%, and on the day 100%.
groups: A private room seats up to 12, for dinners, wine tastings and launches; the restaurant also has a 12-seat counter, a 6-seat oval corner and a 4-seat lounge table.
